recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-26070 requires no further core source work; audits or follow-up for the related spelling/status-code issues should be handled under their own issue keys.
issue_request: FHIR-26070 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking that Appointment invariant app-4 be written relative to the Appointment resource rather than using Appointment.cancelationReason and Appointment.status prefixes.
initial_application: Commit 03d4ad0da7f15f3d5ff0c3917acc06732f7f6eb7 explicitly applied FHIR-26070 by changing app-4 from Appointment.cancelationReason.exists() implies (Appointment.status='no-show' or Appointment.status='cancelled') to a relative cancelationReason/status expression.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml is in current build scope. Later Published corrections FHIR-32768 and FHIR-37896 changed the element spelling to cancellationReason and the status literal to noshow, which explains why current source does not literally match the original issue text while preserving the relative-expression decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current app-4 reads cancellationReason.exists() implies (status='noshow' or status='cancelled'), and a current grep found no remaining prefixed Appointment.cancelationReason.exists() or Appointment.cancellationReason.exists() expression in the Appointment source.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the Appointment element spelling from cancelationReason to cancellationReason, explaining the spelling difference between the seed text and current source.
Corrected app-4's status literal from no-show to the valid Appointment.status code noshow.
Added cancellationDate with a parallel noshow/cancelled invariant, confirming the current cancellation invariant pattern.
